The rescues continue when Weasel's new electro-magnet sucks up Baby Truck and the Mechanicals, and Gecko has to save the day!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Join Gecko for some of his ultimate rescue missions! Blue must face his fear of a storm to save Eric the Excavator, who is stuck in a trench with a dam about to overflow! Then, Weasel fits Vicky the Ice Cream truck with a super-fast rocket, causing her to speed out of control! Gecko and the Mechanicals must stop her before she crashes. From saving a trapped Mummy Truck to rescuing the Mechs, it's always a big adventure!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Let's get healthy with Blippi! He learns to make a raw smoothie, exploring colors, shapes, fruits and vegetables. Then, Mamma Mia! Blippi visits Olio pizza, a real pizza parlor, where he learns how to toss dough, put on toppings and throw the pie into the oven. He practices counting pizza slices before enjoying a delicious bite and an Italian lesson!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Take flight with Blippi Airlines as he visits the Museum of Flight in Seattle and learns about planes! It's time to play! Blippi goes on an adventure to a children's museum to play in Longos-Cove. This hands-on exhibit teaches him all about sand, vegetables, boats and birds! Join Blippi for a day of fun and discovery.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: JJ is learning all about how to share, help and be kind! First, he learns the magic words 'please' and 'thank you,' and what to do when you make a mistake. The lessons continue as JJ, YoYo and TomTom show how much fun it is to share their snacks and toys. Being kind also means being helpful, and JJ's family loves to help each other around the house. From using good manners at the table to learning how to wait in line, it's a day of learning to be a good friend and family member!

No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders

Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big changes! Pogo tries his new hypnosis machine on Jeff, who scoffs at it. But it's not long before Pogo gets Jeff to behave like a dog! Then, Zee and Jeff are forced to live together when Jeff calls fumigators on Zee's house. How long can this alliance of opposites last? Plus, when Newt goes on holiday, Zee is enlisted to house-sit and look after her beloved pet hamster!

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: All set to play Iron Tank for a place in the final, Supa Strikas can't resist a no-rules pick-up game aboard a massive tanker. But when an uninvited guest steers the ship towards disaster, will they rise above rivalry and work together?

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Ready to explore with Blippi? Join him on a special visit to the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, one of the world's biggest zoos! He learns all about the amazing safari animals we share our planet with and what makes them unique. Grab your safari hat, it's time to see the wild animals!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi spends the day at Johnson Brothers Landscaping to learn about construction and landscaping. Blippi learns more about construction vehicles and teaches the basics of how to operate them. Construction worker Blippi is hard at work on a job site today! Watch him operate a bulldozer, dig with an excavator and carry big objects across a wide field! Learn how each vehicle works, always remembering to put safety first!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big day out adventures! First, the family visits the zoo to see all the amazing animals, like elephants, monkeys and hippos! Then, it's Baby John's first time at the water park, where he has lots of fun with water squirters and wading pools. The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars and yummy cotton candy!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Open up Baby John's Big Book of Safety and learn along with him! First, the family learns they must remember their helmets to stay safe on a fun family bike ride. Then, it's time for a trip to the beach, where Mom and Dad teach the kids how to have fun and stay safe as they enjoy the sun and sand. The safety lessons continue at the pool, where Baby John learns the importance of following the rules when swimming.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Meekah is always learning something new and awesome! First, she meets a group of young coders and learns that 'coding' is telling a computer what to do through fun physical games. Then, she learns about the importance of reusing and recycling materials like plastic and paper at the Environmental Learning Center, where she even gets to ride in a real recycling truck! Finally, she plays an exciting game of Alphabet Soup to find all her letters!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah on a magic dragon quest! First, she exercises her body and mind at an indoor playground with a fun matching game. She explores a Doctor's Office, Fire Station and a huge ball pit! Then, Meekah travels to a medieval-themed playground. She meets a Knight and follows dragon footprints through an enchanted castle, climbing walls and sliding down a donut slide to find adorable baby dragons!

It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi and Meekah are learning how to be firefighters! Then, Blippi visits the exciting city of Kidzania to continue his training. After learning about fire safety, he gets to ride in a firetruck and handle the hose to put out a simulated fire. It's an action-packed day of learning and fun!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? Join Blippi as he explores different, exciting occupations through play! He reads the news like a TV anchor, drives a fire truck and sorts letters like a mail carrier.

programme.desc: The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a wild day! An incident with Newt and some local birds causes the accidental launch of Bubbles' rocket into space with the birds inside! Finally, Pogo prides himself on being a master of the prank and sends Bubbles on an elaborate goose-chase into the snowy mountains.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he visits a construction site to learn all about construction vehicles! programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day of caring for cute pets! First, she pretends to be a veterinarian at the Twinkle Play Space! She visits with some cute cats, plays on a giant hamster wheel and then helps her new doggy friend get ready to meet his fur-ever family.

programme.title: Meekah

Then, it's all aboard for a train-tastic journey where he rides the rails and discovers what makes trains such an amazing way to travel.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time to play ball! Blippi is at a real baseball stadium to learn all about the game of baseball. He gets some help from a player, who teaches him how to bat, how to throw, and how to catch. Join Blippi as he learns the rules of the game and has fun running the bases in this gr and slam of an adventure.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo and his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie and tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo and takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel finds the remote to control Arpo, turning the robot babysitter into everything from an elephant to a bird! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Get ready to play! Blippi is counting down his top 10 favorite moments of fun and games. This energetic compilation features Blippi learning new sports, exploring amazing playgrounds, and discovering all sorts of fun ways to play. It's a celebration of being active, learning new skills, and having a great time.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a sweet treat adventure with Meekah! First, she explores different jobs like Firefighter, Grocer and Veterinarian before sliding into a ball pit! Then, she visits Happy Ice in Los Angeles to learn how to make delicious, colorful desserts. The sweet fun continues at the Gingerbread Factory in Leavenworth! Meekah learns to make icing and turns gingerbread shapes into a fun house with cool decorations!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah on a magic dragon quest! First, she exercises her body and mind at an indoor playground with a fun matching game. She explores a Doctor's Office, Fire Station and a huge ball pit! Then, Meekah travels to a medieval-themed playground. She meets a Knight and follows dragon footprints through an enchanted castle, climbing walls and sliding down a donut slide to find adorable baby dragons!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready for an action-packed day of battling evil robots and racing villains! First, the new and improved Robofreeze becomes faulty, and Mila and Morphle must help Officer Freeze retrieve the remote to turn him off! Then, it's time for the Pet Port Rally, but naughty Winston cheats by using sneaky devices to slow everyone down. The chaos continues as two Robofreezes turn evil and multiply, and a lightning strike turns another one into a super-powered menace!

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Tea and Turkey
programme.desc: Tea and turkey are an unlikely combo for a meal, but Chef Robert Jewell is a creative force in the kitchen. First, he gives earl grey and lavender tea a sweet treatment by making a rich semifreddo. Robert creates a silky tea infused syrup, which he drizzles over a luxurious custard and tops with whipped cream. Robert punches up the colour by adding tart poached raspberries and vibrant violet lavender petals. Now, it's time for a real show stopper - saffron turkey kebabs with pomegranate rice. This is not your average turkey dinner. First, Robert marinates the turkey pieces in lime, yogourt and garlic. After infusing basmati rice with aromatic saffron and bay leaves, Robert tosses the rice with crunchy pine nuts and sweet pomegranate - the perfect bed for his grilled to- perfection turkey skewers. Robert then takes his culinary skills to the next level when he uses tea and turkey in one single delicious dish.

programme.title: Mexico + Norway
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.desc: Cheese or chocolate? Why not both! In this "C" challenge, host Theresa Visintin takes on both decadent ingredients. But first, she shows us that being cheesy is easy, especially when you stuff chicken breast with creamy goat's cheese and finely diced apples. Theresa takes the flavour one step further by coating the stuffed chicken with sage, parmesan, and panko bread crumbs, then frying it to a crispy golden brown. Next, Theresa whips up a dessert fan favourite, the decadent and oh-so-irresistible dark chocolate lava cake. Finally, Theresa has an irresistible recipe using ooey gooey cheese and warm chocolate.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Brassica
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo begins his cruciferous crusade with a hearty bowl of broccoli and cauliflower soup, topped with toasted florets and finished with a hit of spicy black mustard. Then he mixes tender confit kohlrabi with some fresh and saucy kohlrabi to create a salad. Next up is a soba noodle stir fry, combining daikon radish with shiitake, scallions, and sesame. Lastly, chef Pino puts together some fluffy frittata-style muffins packed with tomato and spicy arugula leaves. Bravo brassicas!

programme.title: Bursts of Japanese Flavours
programme.desc: Host Hana Etsuke Dethlefsen makes casual Japanese cuisine like Savoury Japanese Pancakes and Gyoza three-ways.

programme.title: Salmon Salad Niçoise
programme.desc: How many ways can salmon be prepared? Up the Dish is on a mission to find out! Tiera Singh's Salmon Salad NiÃ§oise is a staple of the French Riviera with shallot, eggs, and haricot verts, but she swaps out the tuna for luxuriant olive oil poached salmon - it may not be traditional but it sure tastes good! Poppy Sandler smokes the competition with a buttery Smoked Salmon Omelette, garnished with fresh chives and earthy goat cheese. Next, Micah Trainor skips the salmon but keeps the veggies for her steamed Tofu Nori Dim Sum Dumplings, with tart gingERS-pickled shallots and tons of green goodness. Missy Hui has the big finish; her Salmon with Béarnaise is cooked sous vide for a precisely cooked fish dish and served alongside Pommes Anna for a plate that's straight out of Paris.

programme.title: Ireland + Japan
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Dumplings
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Mediterranean Grill & Barnyard Thrills
programme.desc: Fresh ingredients meet bold BBQ flavours as Maddie and Kiki put a smoky spin on Mediterranean favourites. They smoke heirloom tomatoes for a basil and bocconcini salad, glaze grilled mushroom kebabs with balsamic, and finish with juicy lamb souvlaki served alongside cool tzatziki.

programme.title: Smoked Turkey & Sweet Summer Treats
programme.desc: The barn is heating up as Maddie and Kiki serve up a lineup of smoky, savoury, and sweet BBQ favourites! This time, they create their own turkey pastrami, build a spinach salad with bacon and cashews, and turn grilled pineapple into a delicious campfire-inspired treat.

programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are turning up the heat with a BBQ feast full of bold flavours and creative combinations! programme.title: Smoky Prime Rib & Summer Berry Bliss
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are serving up a BBQ feast packed with smoky flavours and creative twists! programme.title: Rotisserie, Plums & Sister Fun
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are bringing global flavours to the grill with a fresh lineup of BBQ favourites! On this episode, they toss together an Asian pasta salad with charred green onions, roast lemon chicken on the spit with chili lime aioli, and grill plums served with lime mascarpone.

programme.title: Grilled Bites & Backyard Delights
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are firing up the grill for a colourful mix of fresh flavours and backyard favourites! On this episode, they make a charred corn, red pepper, and arugula salad, grill a shrimp pizza on flatbread, and serve up lamb sliders topped with Fuji apple chutney.

programme.title: Ribs, Roots & Sweet Rewards
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are embracing big BBQ flavours with a feast of smoky meats, fresh sides, and sweet finishes! On this episode, they smoke whole beef ribs with maple butter acorn squash, grill Korean short ribs with celeriac and apple slaw, and create a strawberry mascarpone trifle.

programme.title: Savory Duck & Refreshing Bites
programme.desc: From smoky mains to fresh summer bites, Maddie and Kiki prove the BBQ is about more than just grilling meat! They whip up tuna bruschetta, pair rich balsamic cherry duck with sweet seasonal flavours, and cool things down with a roasted red pepper gazpacho.

programme.title: Tandoori Treats & Tangy Tenderloin
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are mixing bold marinades and fresh summer flavours for another unforgettable BBQ feast! They grill stout-marinated pork tenderloin with a tangy buttermilk potato salad, turn sweet cantaloupe into a smoky side, and spice things up with tandoori cauliflower.

programme.title: Mexico + Norway
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of baked feta with marinated tomatoes and corn chips, a marinated tomato and jicama salad with cilantro lime dressing, carne molida tacos, and a sous-vide crème caramel.

programme.title: Cassoulet
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Carrot Cake
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Borscht
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Seafood Boil
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab; a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. Loaded with scotch-bonnet peppers, osso bucco, and demi-glace, this dish delivers a rich and impressive punch to the tastebuds.

programme.title: Have Fun
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make avocado toast and tacos, Liam whips up an easy pantry pasta, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a favorite one pot meal!

programme.title: Sharing Is Caring
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs prep rainbow fruit skewers, Liam whips up his charity-inspired cheeseburger soup, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a popular Trinidadian street food, fried bread and saltfish!

programme.title: Everybody’s A Chef
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make pancakes, Liam whips up craveable chicken coconut curry, Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make Nashville fried chicken sandwiches, and more!

programme.title: You Got It
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs test kitchen hacks with eggs, Liam whips up the beef and broccoli stir fry he made for friends as a kid, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a beautiful pistachio pasta and Caesar salad!

programme.title: Fast Favs
programme.desc: For a quick and tasty meal, chef Spencer Watts cooks up fast favs using scallops and trout, all done in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: Fruit
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts mixes the sweet flavours of fruit with fish as he makes dishes with salmon and scallops.

programme.title: Dairy
programme.desc: Seafood and dairy make the perfect partners. Watch as Chef Spencer Watts creates some dairy-infused dishes using red snapper and scampi.

programme.title: Tart
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts makes tastebuds dance as he creates recipes that combine sour and tart flavours with grouper and clams.

programme.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Veal Piccata
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Scotland, France, USA, Myanmar
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by Scotland, France, the USA, and Myanmar!

programme.title: Versatile Indian Flavours
programme.desc: Host Vijaya Selvaraju makes delectable Indian dishes using versatile Indian spices and flavours.

programme.title: Papaya Salad, Carrot Hog Dogs, Squid, and Tofu
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford unveils four spellbinding dishes! First up, green papaya salad with crispy pork! Next, BBQ carrot hot dogs! Followed by grilled squid steak! Finishing with Korean BBQ tofu!

programme.title: Yellow
programme.desc: Say hello to yellow with chef Pino Di Cerbo as he brightens each dish with glowing, golden-hued produce! Corn on the cob gets a fun presentation as 'ribs', chopped into spears, spiked with harissa spices, and grilled until smoky. Next is a sweet and sour detour with mangoes and lemons in a no-bake cheesecake with a unique popped amaranth crust. Next, aromatic and hearty Kerala-style curry includes all things gold and beautiful: creamy yellow potatoes, sweet yellow peppers, even snappy yellow beans! Finally, stick around for a Thai-inspired noodle salad, where even the noodles are veggies! Strands of mildly sweet spaghetti squash paired with nutty cashews, tender sprouts and a punchy ginger-rice vinaigrette!

programme.title: Hearty Weeknight Multi-Cooker Dishes
programme.desc: Do you know the secret to an uncracked cheesecake? Host Vanessa Gianfrancesco shares her trick to making a perfectly silky-smooth Salted Caramel Cheesecake.

programme.title: Spaghetti
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Coffee, Tea
programme.desc: Caffeine isn't just to get you going in the morning. Chef Spencer Watts shows how tea and coffee can add a lot of flavour to tuna and mussels.

programme.title: Surf and Turf
programme.desc: Get the best of both land and sea as Chef Spencer Watts creates fun surf and turf dishes featuring halibut and lobster.

programme.title: Whole

programme.title: SOLDIER STORIES
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: INFAMOUSE COLORADO CANNIBAL
programme.desc: It was a flood of biblical proportion rampaging for two months, cutting a swath across 9 Midwestern states killing 50 people and destroying or damaging 55,000 homes. Hardin, Missouri, population a little over 600, was a small, close-knit farming community. Residents watched over each other and their history by taking exceptional care of the local cemetery where their ancestors rested. What the inhabitants of this small Missouri town came to realize was that the Great Midwest Flood of 1993 would have the ability to unearth the dead as the Missouri river flowed three and a half miles over its banks. The floodwaters ate through the Hardin cemetery, unearthing hundreds of headstones, vaults and caskets, sending them through the streets and fields of Ray County. As the disaster unfolded, a special team comprised of local volunteers and forensic anthropologists, pathologists and other specialists brought together by DMORT (Disaster Mortuary Operational Response Team) came from as far away as Washington, DC in a massive effort to recover, identify, and repatriate the hundreds of individuals exhumed by the floodwaters. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray and some members of this unique crew will re-explore the extraordinary efforts that were undertaken to once again bring to rest the displaced remains, and provide closure for the living.

programme.title: CAREER CRIMINAL
programme.desc: A loving mother disappears without explanation in Arlington, Texas. Investigators suspect foul play but search fruitlessly for any sign of her whereabouts. When investigators discover a link between the woman’s disappearance and another murder nearly two decades earlier, they contact Prosecutor Sandy Gately. It will be up to her to re-open a 16-year-old case and work with limited evidence to bring bring to justice a criminal responsible for multiple murders.

programme.title: DEAD MED DO TALK
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: MASS GRAVES OF GUATEMALA
programme.desc: From as early as 1876, there were rumors of ghosts inhabiting the building that now houses the Cincinnati Symphony, so when a night watchman would tell of his sightings nearly 100 years later, many thought he was just adding to lore. But then in 1988 when construction workers were working in one of the elevator shafts, they uncovered hundreds of pounds of skeletal remains in an underground crypt. Dr. Elizabeth Murray was eventually entrusted with the bones and set about to solve the mystery; how did these bones end up where they did and who might these individuals be? Records would eventually indicate that the original building that would eventually become today’s Music Hall was built atop the city’s nineteenth century public burial ground for commoners and indigents. The bones themselves would paint a picture of Cincinnati’s first settlers. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray will take us back in time and tell us how she, as a forensic anthropologist, along with the assistance of a small crew of experts, was able to solve this mystery.

programme.title: SILENCER
programme.desc: On September 18, 1985, the life of a small-town bank president is shattered when he receives a call from an unknown man who has kidnapped his wife. The kidnapper demands a ransom for her safe return. When local police respond to the home, they find the woman dead, shot seven times. The FBI is called in and an intense investigation ensues. The case is broken when a man comes forward with the murder weapon, leading to two arrests. With the testimony of one of the co-conspirators and a mountain of circumstantial evidence, it would be up to Assistant District Attorneys Sam Ponder and Charlie Strauss to prove that Lesley Lee Gosch was the mastermind of the extortion plot, and a remorseless murderer.

programme.title: THE REAL JEWELS OF SOUTH AFRICA
programme.desc: Hosts Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey to the heart of South Africa, where they reveal that the nation’s true brilliance shines not from its famous diamonds, but from the resilience and spirit of its people. The episode begins in Johannesburg, a city forged by gold and hardened by resistance. Kolyn and Lindsey delve into the profound legacy of Nelson Mandela, tracing his transformation from an activist to a revolutionary leader who introduced the mining charter. This segment explores how a history of struggle became a foundation for national strength. The narrative shifts from social history to the literal 'sparkle' of the land with a trip to the Kimberley Big Hole. Here, the team explores the origins of the global diamond rush. They meet Molefi Letsiki, a Diamondtaires and the world’s first Black Sightholder—one of only 70 globally—whose success is a testament to a legacy fulfilled. The deep dive continues 1,500 feet underground at the Venetia Mine. This offers a high-stakes, never-before-seen look at modern diamond production, highlighting the industry's critical shift toward community empowerment and sustainability. The episode concludes by examining the 'Future' of the facet. It showcases how South Africa's ancient craft and natural resources are being re-embraced by a new generation of leaders, artists, and entrepreneurs. Through every interview—from museum educators to diamond executives—one message remains clear: while the diamonds may glisten, the people are The Real Jewels Of South Africa.

programme.desc: From as early as 1876, there were rumors of ghosts inhabiting the building that now houses the Cincinnati Symphony, so when a night watchman would tell of his sightings nearly 100 years later, many thought he was just adding to lore. But then in 1988 when construction workers were working in one of the elevator shafts, they uncovered hundreds of pounds of skeletal remains in an underground crypt. Dr. Elizabeth Murray was eventually entrusted with the bones and set about to solve the mystery; how did these bones end up where they did and who might these individuals be? Records would eventually indicate that the original building that would eventually become today’s Music Hall was built atop the city’s nineteenth century public burial ground for commoners and indigents. The bones themselves would paint a picture of Cincinnati’s first settlers. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray will take us back in time and tell us how she, as a forensic anthropologist, along with the assistance of a small crew of experts, was able to solve this mystery.

programme.title: SILENCER
programme.desc: On September 18, 1985, the life of a small-town bank president is shattered when he receives a call from an unknown man who has kidnapped his wife. The kidnapper demands a ransom for her safe return. When local police respond to the home, they find the woman dead, shot seven times. The FBI is called in and an intense investigation ensues. The case is broken when a man comes forward with the murder weapon, leading to two arrests. With the testimony of one of the co-conspirators and a mountain of circumstantial evidence, it would be up to Assistant District Attorneys Sam Ponder and Charlie Strauss to prove that Lesley Lee Gosch was the mastermind of the extortion plot, and a remorseless murderer.

programme.title: MATERIAL WITNESS
programme.desc: The FBI suspects’ fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

programme.title: SOUTH AFRICA UNCORKED: SOUL, SEA & SAFARI
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature’s masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that's chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australia's best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head, in Battle of the Alphas.

programme.title: Wild Science

programme.title: Wild Philippines

programme.desc: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

But one Doobydoo is too ambitious and stays back to pick the last Tika Pila flower, but that awakes the Tika Pila monster and he shouts the biggest shout ever, scaring Tiggy and making the pie fly up high and splatter down on his face! programme.title: Colour Chaos
programme.desc: Mayor decide what colour to paint the town hall as it is so dull and grey. So Deedee offers to help, without magic this time, by getting a town vote as to which colour is liked best. Deedee and Nino go ahead and do just that, asking each and everybody they see in Abra-Dabra and noting their choice of colours. Boris and Sandy are confused so set out to paint and decide, but end up messing up the wall. They seek the help of Deedee, who is all so ready to help. But Nino is scared things will get worse with the powerful magic spell, and with good reason. The spell not only "cleaned" Charlie’s wall but made grey stripes on the walls of every house in Abra-Dabra! Even Tiggy’s yellow house is all grey!! So Deedee and everybody else pitch in and paint every house back to its original colour. So the final building standing is the town hall, but no one has sufficient pain for any one colour. So they finally decide to paint it with every colour they have, like a rainbow!

programme.title: Tiggy's Big Feast
programme.desc: Tiggy is all flustered and confused as he’s not prepared, nor has any idea what to make for a surprise lunch he promised Mayor De Pfeffel. Seems Deedee’s magic is the only answer. The spell she conjures makes Tiggy be totally decided on the recipe that he sees first. And when the spell is cast, the recipe book opens up exactly at the recipe of a pie made of Tika Pila flowers. The problem is that only the Doobydoos can pick the Tika Pila flowers as it grows in the most prickly cacti in Abra-Dabra! But no matter how much Deedee and Nino coax Tiggy to work on another recipe; Tiggy is totally fixated on the Tika Pila flower pie. Though the Doobydoos love eating the flowers, they are too scared of the loud and angry Tika Pila monster that guards them and rush off in a hurry. They finally hit a bargain with Tiggy in exchange for a hundred custard sandwiches. Only with much reassuring and coaxing they pick every Tika Pila flower around. Mayor De Pfeffel is already at Tiggy’s and really hungry. But one Doobydoo is too ambitious and stays back to pick the last Tika Pila flower, but that awakes the Tika Pila monster and he shouts the biggest shout ever, scaring Tiggy and making the pie fly up high and splatter down on his face! The inevitable terrible has happened and there is nothing to give the Mayor. Just then when things couldn’t get any worse Mayor De Pfeffel lunges inside and is happy to see a whole plate of his favourite custard sandwiches.

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. They decide to wear-out the whirlwind safely without magic. They come up with a plan and together do their thing. The whirlwind gradually gets tired and so does the magic wear off. Although it messed up the town, all of them have quite a laugh.

programme.desc: Mewmew is out exploring with a spring in his step and song in his mouth. Deedee and Nino are surprised to hear him sing and sets up a proposition for Mewmew to sing at the concert hall with Tiggys lemonade stand nearby. The concert is all set and so is Tiggys

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. They decide to wear-out the whirlwind safely without magic. They come up with a plan and together do their thing. The whirlwind gradually gets tired and so does the magic wear off. Although it messed up the town, all of them have quite a laugh.

programme.title: Bubble Cars
programme.desc: As Deedee and Nino were wondering what Charlie got the twins for their birthday, Sandy whizzes past in a brand new pedal car. Boris got one too, but he doesn’t want his to get dirty at all. So he decides not to use it at all even though he misses all the fun Sandy is having. Mewmew and Sandy even have a race across town. Boris even declines a chance to race, but is entirely sceptical about it as he doesn’t even want a splash of mud to fall on it. He is even more worried when he sees Sandy’s car not working. Deedee tries to help by magically trying to create a bubble guard around Boris’s car, but the spell falls on Sandy’s car instead. Now no one can even touch the car, let alone repair it. Boris vouches to allow Sandy use his car as he acknowledges that it was his undoing that led to the creation of the bubble in the first place. Sandy is overjoyed and promises to be extra careful. So careful that Mewmew can even beat her by running on his ears. Deedee tells Boris to prove to Sandy that she can use the car faster, so Boris races with Mewmew and accidentally splashes mud over his face, but then is happy he does and enjoys the fun. He races so fast that he pops the bubble guard over Sandy’s car by crashing into it. Charlie sets down to fix the cars and the twins are driving them in a jiffy, giggling all the way.

programme.desc: Charlie is found napping on the job. Deedee and Nino encourage him as being the best postman ever and that anyone would doze off in the sweltering heat.

programme.title: Bubble Cars
programme.desc: As Deedee and Nino were wondering what Charlie got the twins for their birthday, Sandy whizzes past in a brand new pedal car. Boris got one too, but he doesn’t want his to get dirty at all. So he decides not to use it at all even though he misses all the fun Sandy is having. Mewmew and Sandy even have a race across town. Boris even declines a chance to race, but is entirely sceptical about it as he doesn’t even want a splash of mud to fall on it. He is even more worried when he sees Sandy’s car not working. Deedee tries to help by magically trying to create a bubble guard around Boris’s car, but the spell falls on Sandy’s car instead. Now no one can even touch the car, let alone repair it. Boris vouches to allow Sandy use his car as he acknowledges that it was his undoing that led to the creation of the bubble in the first place. Sandy is overjoyed and promises to be extra careful. So careful that Mewmew can even beat her by running on his ears. Deedee tells Boris to prove to Sandy that she can use the car faster, so Boris races with Mewmew and accidentally splashes mud over his face, but then is happy he does and enjoys the fun. He races so fast that he pops the bubble guard over Sandy’s car by crashing into it. Charlie sets down to fix the cars and the twins are driving them in a jiffy, giggling all the way.

programme.title: Colour Chaos
programme.desc: Mayor decide what colour to paint the town hall as it is so dull and grey. So Deedee offers to help, without magic this time, by getting a town vote as to which colour is liked best. Deedee and Nino go ahead and do just that, asking each and everybody they see in Abra-Dabra and noting their choice of colours. Boris and Sandy are confused so set out to paint and decide, but end up messing up the wall. They seek the help of Deedee, who is all so ready to help. But Nino is scared things will get worse with the powerful magic spell, and with good reason. The spell not only "cleaned" Charlie’s wall but made grey stripes on the walls of every house in Abra-Dabra! Even Tiggy’s yellow house is all grey!! So Deedee and everybody else pitch in and paint every house back to its original colour. So the final building standing is the town hall, but no one has sufficient pain for any one colour. So they finally decide to paint it with every colour they have, like a rainbow!

programme.title: Tiggy's Big Feast
programme.desc: Tiggy is all flustered and confused as he’s not prepared, nor has any idea what to make for a surprise lunch he promised Mayor De Pfeffel. Seems Deedee’s magic is the only answer. The spell she conjures makes Tiggy be totally decided on the recipe that he sees first. And when the spell is cast, the recipe book opens up exactly at the recipe of a pie made of Tika Pila flowers. The problem is that only the Doobydoos can pick the Tika Pila flowers as it grows in the most prickly cacti in Abra-Dabra! But no matter how much Deedee and Nino coax Tiggy to work on another recipe; Tiggy is totally fixated on the Tika Pila flower pie. Though the Doobydoos love eating the flowers, they are too scared of the loud and angry Tika Pila monster that guards them and rush off in a hurry. They finally hit a bargain with Tiggy in exchange for a hundred custard sandwiches. Only with much reassuring and coaxing they pick every Tika Pila flower around. Mayor De Pfeffel is already at Tiggy’s and really hungry. But one Doobydoo is too ambitious and stays back to pick the last Tika Pila flower, but that awakes the Tika Pila monster and he shouts the biggest shout ever, scaring Tiggy and making the pie fly up high and splatter down on his face! The inevitable terrible has happened and there is nothing to give the Mayor. Just then when things couldn’t get any worse Mayor De Pfeffel lunges inside and is happy to see a whole plate of his favourite custard sandwiches.

programme.title: Colour Chaos
programme.desc: Mayor decide what colour to paint the town hall as it is so dull and grey. So Deedee offers to help, without magic this time, by getting a town vote as to which colour is liked best. Deedee and Nino go ahead and do just that, asking each and everybody they see in Abra-Dabra and noting their choice of colours. Boris and Sandy are confused so set out to paint and decide, but end up messing up the wall. They seek the help of Deedee, who is all so ready to help. But Nino is scared things will get worse with the powerful magic spell, and with good reason. The spell not only "cleaned" Charlie’s wall but made grey stripes on the walls of every house in Abra-Dabra! Even Tiggy’s yellow house is all grey!! So Deedee and everybody else pitch in and paint every house back to its original colour. So the final building standing is the town hall, but no one has sufficient pain for any one colour. So they finally decide to paint it with every colour they have, like a rainbow!

programme.title: Tiggy's Big Feast
programme.desc: Tiggy is all flustered and confused as he’s not prepared, nor has any idea what to make for a surprise lunch he promised Mayor De Pfeffel. Seems Deedee’s magic is the only answer. The spell she conjures makes Tiggy be totally decided on the recipe that he sees first. And when the spell is cast, the recipe book opens up exactly at the recipe of a pie made of Tika Pila flowers. The problem is that only the Doobydoos can pick the Tika Pila flowers as it grows in the most prickly cacti in Abra-Dabra! But no matter how much Deedee and Nino coax Tiggy to work on another recipe; Tiggy is totally fixated on the Tika Pila flower pie. Though the Doobydoos love eating the flowers, they are too scared of the loud and angry Tika Pila monster that guards them and rush off in a hurry. They finally hit a bargain with Tiggy in exchange for a hundred custard sandwiches. Only with much reassuring and coaxing they pick every Tika Pila flower around. Mayor De Pfeffel is already at Tiggy’s and really hungry. But one Doobydoo is too ambitious and stays back to pick the last Tika Pila flower, but that awakes the Tika Pila monster and he shouts the biggest shout ever, scaring Tiggy and making the pie fly up high and splatter down on his face! The inevitable terrible has happened and there is nothing to give the Mayor. Just then when things couldn’t get any worse Mayor De Pfeffel lunges inside and is happy to see a whole plate of his favourite custard sandwiches.

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. They decide to wear-out the whirlwind safely without magic. They come up with a plan and together do their thing. The whirlwind gradually gets tired and so does the magic wear off. Although it messed up the town, all of them have quite a laugh.

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. They decide to wear-out the whirlwind safely without magic. They come up with a plan and together do their thing. The whirlwind gradually gets tired and so does the magic wear off. Although it messed up the town, all of them have quite a laugh.

programme.title: Mewmews Hiccups
programme.desc: Mewmew is out exploring with a spring in his step and song in his mouth. Deedee and Nino are surprised to hear him sing and sets up a proposition for Mewmew to sing at the concert hall with Tiggys lemonade stand nearby. The concert is all set and so is Tiggys

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: The documentary Queen Camilla? takes a closer look at Camilla Parker-Bowles, covering her history, her life, and what lies ahead. programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S03:E09 - Hack Green Bunker
programme.desc: Gregg enters the bunker for the first time and feels its energy. Has he caught the voice of the mysterious woman that some believe was murdered there?

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S03:E10 - Eden Camp Museum
programme.desc: Once a prison camp during WWII, Eden Camp is now a museum housing many an artefact and many a ghost. Karl enters the cottage to face the spirits that are said to haunt this once family home.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E01 - Hell Has A Name
programme.desc: At the start of Season Two of Dropped, we get a closer look at the adventures on the way to Base Camp and sheep camp.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E11 - Dump Site
programme.desc: Montana U.S.A. Region 4 Wardens find a deer in the dumpster, multiple deer dumped alongside the road and a deer left by a trespasser. It's all in a long day's work.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E12 - Hidden Truth
programme.desc: When Wardens stop a truck on the first of November with Christmas trees in the back, they know something is being hidden. Most likely the truth.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E01 - A Pirates Life For Terry
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test out the weapons of pirate movies old and new.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E02 - Terry Loves 70's Cop Shows
programme.desc: Terry travels back in time to the '70s where he gets to relive his childhood dreams of becoming a '70s TV cop. Larry helps Terry test several scenarios, including hiding behind a car door for cover, and if you can really shoot a gas tank from a car to make it explode.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E01 - Sinking Cities
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. In this episode, travel with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore across the region to understand what is causing cities to sink, how they are being monitored, and why building resilience into communities is critical to their long-term survival.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S03:E09 - Hack Green Bunker
programme.desc: Gregg enters the bunker for the first time and feels its energy. Has he caught the voice of the mysterious woman that some believe was murdered there?

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S03:E10 - Eden Camp Museum
programme.desc: Once a prison camp during WWII, Eden Camp is now a museum housing many an artefact and many a ghost. Karl enters the cottage to face the spirits that are said to haunt this once family home.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: This show offers a captivating look into the extraordinary life of one of the 20th century's most fascinating women, seen through an American lens. It features clips from the auction where her dresses were sold.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: The documentary Queen Camilla? takes a closer look at Camilla Parker-Bowles, covering her history, her life, and what lies ahead. It focuses on her long standing ties with Prince Charles. The film also delves into the drama around Camilla's role in Prince Charles's marriage to Princess Diana.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E01 - Hell Has A Name
programme.desc: At the start of Season Two of Dropped, we get a closer look at the adventures on the way to Base Camp and sheep camp.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E02 - Horses Can Think...Rafts Can't
programme.desc: In episode two, Casey continues where they left off. They're faced with a choice. Once they've settled into a risky spot on the mountain, they see that the ram they were after isn't legal to hunt, so they have to retreat.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E13 - Back Country Patrol
programme.desc: Wardens do way more than just drive around in trucks and check licenses. This week the Region One wardens go off the grid to protect the natural resources of Montana U.S.A.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E14 - Double Kill
programme.desc: Montana U.S.A. Region 5 has a rash of illegal elk kills and it's down to the Wardens to investigate them.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E03 - Breaking Terry Badly
programme.desc: Terry falls victim to Walter White in Breaking Bad, and Terry and Larry test 3 separate scenes from this iconic series, two of which need the help of Special Effects expert Andre Ellingson, including lighting a gas tank on fire and chemically burning through a steel door.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E04 - Larry's Shadow
programme.desc: Larry gets sucked into Terry's dark and mysterious world because Terry wants to test two scenes from the 1994 film with Alec Baldwin, The Shadow. Terry will find out if they can save a man trapped in cement shoes, and then they will do a seemingly impossible test.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E03 - Urban Oceans, Super Corals
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. Dive with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore as they investigate the impact climate change is having on the ocean, explore engineering ideas for artificial reefs, and discover a coral species showing resilience to climate change.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: Remembering Diana, Princess of Wales includes scenes from her state funeral and heartfelt words from her closest friends. It's a warm and reflective look at Diana both as a person and a public figure: the queen that never was and the princess who'll always be remembered.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E02 - Horses Can Think...Rafts Can't
programme.desc: In episode two, Casey continues where they left off. They're faced with a choice. Once they've settled into a risky spot on the mountain, they see that the ram they were after isn't legal to hunt, so they have to retreat.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E13 - Back Country Patrol
programme.desc: Wardens do way more than just drive around in trucks and check licenses. This week the Region One wardens go off the grid to protect the natural resources of Montana U.S.A.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E14 - Double Kill
programme.desc: Montana U.S.A. Region 5 has a rash of illegal elk kills and it's down to the Wardens to investigate them.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E03 - Breaking Terry Badly
programme.desc: Terry falls victim to Walter White in Breaking Bad, and Terry and Larry test 3 separate scenes from this iconic series, two of which need the help of Special Effects expert Andre Ellingson, including lighting a gas tank on fire and chemically burning through a steel door.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E04 - Larry's Shadow
programme.desc: Larry gets sucked into Terry's dark and mysterious world because Terry wants to test two scenes from the 1994 film with Alec Baldwin, The Shadow. Terry will find out if they can save a man trapped in cement shoes, and then they will do a seemingly impossible test.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E03 - Urban Oceans, Super Corals
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. Dive with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore as they investigate the impact climate change is having on the ocean, explore engineering ideas for artificial reefs, and discover a coral species showing resilience to climate change.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.
